name: hvax-ingest
description: Chrome and Safari extension: watch every image on a page and POST it to hvaxd.

scripts.safari: npm run build:safari && xcodebuild -project safari/hvax-ingest.xcodeproj -scheme 'hvax ingest' -configuration Release -derivedDataPath safari/build MARKETING_VERSION=$npm_package_version build
scripts.test:safari: npm run build:safari && node tests/background-fallback.mjs dist-safari && node tests/stats-ascii.mjs dist-safari && node tests/too-small.mjs dist-safari
scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/background-fallback.mjs && node tests/backend-skip.mjs && node tests/stats-ascii.mjs && node tests/too-small.mjs
